# Code Anchors: PR-Driven Post-Merge Flow

- `libs/workspace/src/canonical-remote.ts` — the one rule deciding which declared remote names the repository work is contributed to, and the repository reference the platform client is pointed at (#628)
- `libs/workspace/src/canonical-remote.spec.ts` — pins the upstream-then-origin choice, the exact-name match that ignores a similarly named mirror, and the forge-reference shape (#628)
- `libs/workspace/src/identity.ts` — derives the repository identity a close record stamps from that same remote, labelling which remote it came from (#628)
- `libs/pr-worktree/src/worktree.ts` — fetches the pull-request head and resolves the trunk the closure branch is cut from, both under that rule (#628)
- `libs/pr-worktree/src/range-read.ts` — the worktree-free head fetch the fix and intake lanes use, under the same rule (#628)
- `libs/pr-worktree/src/member-target.ts` — parses a reference in each accepted shape and resolves it to a target checkout, matched only against the hub manifest, with the undeclared-repository and missing-checkout refusals; its identity now comes from the canonical remote (#628)
- `libs/pr-worktree/src/member-target.spec.ts` — coverage for every reference shape, the case-insensitive member match, and both refusals (#520)
- `libs/pr-worktree/src/identity.ts` — the role gate for this flow; a member pointer is refused up front, naming the hub and the epic-addressed close as the replacement.
- `libs/pr-worktree/src/identity.spec.ts` — proves closure's member rejection and role resolution
- `libs/pr-worktree/src/pr.ts` — resolves a pull request's merge state and commit identifiers, carries its body, closing issues and commit messages, and names the repository explicitly so the platform read and the git read cannot disagree (#628)
- `libs/pr-worktree/src/pr.spec.ts` — proves merge-state resolution with an injected runner, and that the repository is named when one resolves (#628)
- `libs/pr-worktree/src/range.ts` — derives the close range anchored on the merge commit and verified against the pull-request head; correct for squash, true-merge and rebase, refusing an empty, non-ancestor or unverifiable range
- `libs/pr-worktree/src/range.spec.ts` — proves range correctness against real squash, merge-commit and rebase topologies
- `libs/pr-acceptance/src/verify.ts` — the published-verdict reader, which filters a block whose stamped repository differs from the one read before newest-wins selection, and parses the stamped repository and story numbers, plus the stamped record reference and digest (#521)
- `libs/pr-acceptance/src/verify.spec.ts` — pins the repository-scoped trust filter, the acceptance of an unstamped older block, and the changed-file exclusions (#521)
- `libs/pr-worktree/src/run.ts` — the single git and platform-CLI process seam every step runs through, so specs can inject a runner
- `libs/pr-worktree/src/diagnostic.ts` — the typed failure shapes the shim surfaces with named exit codes (#520)
- `libs/pr-worktree/src/render.ts` — the one-JSON-object success output and named diagnostics the shim prints
- `libs/portable-tools/src/nexus-cli.ts` — the verb surface: which reference shapes each mode accepts, the story-resolution verb, the verbs reading a story's published verdict back, and the verb that answers which trunk the stages read (#628)
- `libs/portable-tools/src/nexus-cli.spec.ts` — pins that trunk verb's two output forms and its argument handling (#628)
- `components/skills/nxs-pr-worktree/SKILL.md` — the shim doc: the subcommands, the accepted reference shapes, and which modes admit a member
- `components/commands/nxs.analyze.md` — the conformance mode: a worktree at the pull-request head in the resolved target repository, the verdict published as a review carrying the machine-readable block, and the aggregate branch that reads those verdicts back for the epic (#521)
- `components/commands/nxs.close.md` — the close specification, which hard-blocks a member checkout on every path and carries no member-specific step.
- `components/commands/nxs.distill.md` — the continuation mode that resumes in the closure worktree and derives its diff from the stamped range
- `libs/pr-worktree/src/range-list.ts` — the same merge-anchored derivation called once per pull request, so an epic that shipped as several of them stamps one entry each (#523)
- `libs/pr-worktree/src/trunk-check.ts` — verifies the trunk holds every stamped head before the closure branch is cut from it (#523)
- `libs/pr-worktree/src/story-candidates.ts` — the candidate assembly the post-merge run resolves its stories through (#778)
- `libs/epic-verdicts/src/pr-verdict.ts` — the published verdict, no longer carrying the retired code-staleness fields (#778)
